title: PVP Kill effects
description: Epic PvP kill effects with lightning, sounds and custom death messages.
body:
# PvPKillEffects

**PvPKillEffects** adds epic effects whenever a player gets killed in PvP combat.

## Features

* ⚡ Lightning effect at the victim's death location.
* 🔊 Global Wither spawn sound for all online players.
* 💬 Custom death message.
* 🚀 Lightweight and optimized for Paper servers.
* 🎮 Easy to use with no complicated setup.

## Command

* `/testsound` – Plays the Wither spawn sound for all online players.

## Compatibility

* Paper 1.21+

## Perfect for

* Lifesteal servers
* SMP servers
* PvP events
* Hardcore worlds
* Survival servers

Make every PvP kill feel powerful and memorable with **PvPKillEffects**!
